name: Storm Knight — Order of the Inconstant Star
description: The Order of the Inconstant Star charts the unknown and preserves the accumulated wisdom of the Vanguard Reaches. Its knights serve as navigators, scholars, and ambassadors — using their psionic gifts to sense safe paths through jump space and to read the intentions of those they meet. Entry demands an exceptionally sharp mind.

wayfinder.name: Wayfinder
wayfinder.description: You pilot and navigate vessels across the Reaches, using psionic intuition to supplement conventional astrogation.

sage.name: Sage
sage.description: You compile, protect, and transmit the lore of the Order, conducting research and training new initiates.

herald.name: Herald
herald.description: You serve as an envoy and negotiator, travelling between star systems to broker treaties and gather intelligence.

mishaps.1: Your ship is lost in a misjump. Roll END 8+; if you fail, roll on the Injury table. Lose one Benefit roll.
mishaps.2: Your psionic readings prove catastrophically incorrect. Lose one Benefit roll and an Ally becomes a Rival.
mishaps.3: A rival Order manipulates your work to claim credit. Lose one rank.
mishaps.4: You are stranded on a hostile world and must survive alone for months. Gain Survival 1 but lose one Benefit roll.
mishaps.5: Negotiations you conduct break down violently. Gain an Enemy.
mishaps.6: Your accumulated research is destroyed by sabotage. Lose EDU -1.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishaps table.
events.3: You discover a new jump route through a particularly hazardous region. Gain Astrogation 1 or Navigation 1 and DM+1 to one Benefit roll.
events.4: A lengthy voyage exposes you to alien cultures and technologies. Gain Science 1 or Electronics 1.
events.5: Your telepathic sensitivity warns you of a betrayal before it occurs. Gain Telepathy 1 and a Contact.
events.6: You are selected to present your research at an interstellar conclave. Gain SOC +1 and D3 Contacts.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Life Events table.
events.8: You discover a long-lost archive of pre-Collapse knowledge. Gain EDU +1 and an additional Benefit roll.
events.9: A noble of another polity seeks your guidance on a diplomatic crisis. Gain Diplomat 1 or Persuade 1, and the noble as an Ally.
events.10: You successfully navigate a region declared impossible by conventional astrogation. Gain DM+2 on your next advancement roll.
events.11: Your services to the Order earn you a position of honour. Gain SOC +1 and an immediate promotion.
events.12: You make a discovery that rewrites understanding of a major historical event. Gain EDU +2 and SOC +1.
